The merge computes the second task vector against the already-modified tensor (`f2 - tmp` where `tmp = b + lambda*(f1 - b)`) instead of against the unmodified base, giving `b + λ(f1-b) + λ(f2 - b - λ(f1-b))`, which differs from the required formula `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)` in step 2 of "Required result". This is exactly the ordering hazard the specification warns about, and the resulting values will exceed the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance for the 48 merged tensors.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
